findings.issue: Spec section 7 says the fourth bet with no raise of our own (re-raise-not-mine, raise -> call at the cap) is 'covered by SPEC-01's cap check', but the only cap check is R5, an own-raise route that reads re-raise. No route reaches re-raise-not-mine at betCount 4, although all six new Why texts claim 'If a fourth bet has already capped the betting, a raise becomes a call.'
findings.evidence: The AC#1 test checks capped behaviour only through ROUTES 'R5' (CO re-raise). R1-R12 and the 3/7-seat routes all face exactly two raises when they read re-raise-not-mine. The behaviour is right today because the cap logic in recommendPreflop is situation-agnostic, but nothing pins it for the new situation.
findings.fix: Add a route such as BB 3: [r(4,8), f(5), f(6), f(1), f(2), c(3,4), ... ] or a cold 4-bet route like six('R13', 3, [r(4,8), r(5,12), r(6,16), f(1), f(2)], 'BB', 're-raise-not-mine') to ROUTES and assert recommendPreflop(viewAt(r13,'AA')) gives cell.action 'raise' and action 'call'.

summary: situationOf implements A-2 exactly as specified: `mine` is computed from the same blind-free, voided-free records as the raise count, and the data-driven `split` fallback keeps heads-up and full ring on re-raise (pinned by the two 9-seat routes, the 2/9-seat 300-hand sweeps and the spot-list checks; heads-up.json and full-ring.json are byte-identical to base). The new test would fail if either the mine check or the fallback were broken (R3 catches 'any action by viewer', the 9-seat routes catch a missing fallback). All 12 Why texts match their grids hand by hand (checked against chart:print), the re-raise texts no longer claim cold or called-then-3-bet routes, the not-mine grids satisfy the subset/premium/width rules (tested, with the KTo/A7s mutation check), and the only re-raise grid change is CO A9o F -> C*/F as D-8 allows. Rock ranges {AA,KK,QQ,AKs,AKo} are TAG non-fold in every new spot and narrower. Every locked re-pin keeps its assertions: count bumps only, R8/R9 own routes plus six not-mine scripts, the voided-raise :74 flip, and under A-8 the maniac/calling-station examples keep street/hole-card/bet/draw/decision assertions (Example G adds a check), and games seed 42 -> 43 keeps all three > 0 checks. The `as SpotType` cast in tag.ts copies the existing style-check.ts:119 pattern and does not change behaviour. One MINOR: no test covers the fourth-bet cap for the not-mine situation. The targeted vitest run passed (6 files, 142 tests).
